# superset_database (Data Source)

Looks up a database connection by its name, for example to reference its id or to check its settings. The lookup fails when no connection has exactly that name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "superset_database" "warehouse" {
  database_name = "Warehouse"
}

resource "superset_dataset" "sales" {
  table_name    = "sales"
  database_name = data.superset_database.warehouse.database_name
  schema        = "public"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_name` (String) Name of the connection. The comparison is exact.

### Read-Only

- `allow_dml` (Boolean) Whether SQL Lab may run statements that modify data.
- `allow_run_async` (Boolean) Whether queries run asynchronously.
- `backend` (String) SQLAlchemy dialect of the connection, for example `postgresql`.
- `expose_in_sqllab` (Boolean) Whether the connection is available in SQL Lab.
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the connection.
- `uuid` (String) UUID of the connection, as export bundles reference it.
